text:
nate: legal wants a field in audit exports that proves which routing policy and rollout flags were evaluated for each change. can we include that without duplicating tons of data?

priya: yes. attach a small anchor string to each ndjson line and emit a manifest sidecar that maps anchors -> snapshot-hash. snapshots live in /snapshots/ and are deduped.

oliver: signing: we should sign only the manifest (detached sig) using cluster KMS. consumers can verify manifest.sig and then fetch referenced snapshots by hash. cheap and tamper-evident.

nate: console UX: offer "Include provenance anchors (recommended)" checkbox. admins only. show estimated size delta.

priya: API: `GET /exports?provenance=anchors|expanded|none` default anchors. expanded inlines snapshot per-row for easier tooling but costs more.

security-bot: reminder: snapshots may contain tenant identifiers. default to pseudonymize names, require `export:resolved_names` permission to include originals. log access.

infra-bot: heavy exports will count against export-heavy quotas. adding anchors is tiny; expanded mode should be rate-limited.

oliver: lifecycle: once signed, mark bundle as sealed. any edits create a new artifact referencing original sealed bundle. update S3 lifecycle tags accordingly.

nate: action items: oliver -> PoC signer & verify CLI (this week), priya -> API param + sanitize rules, nate -> console wording + checkbox. will loop in compliance after PoC.

priya: I'll add a small manifest sample to the docs and a minimal OpenAPI change.

nate: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
